package.description: Open CoreUI - A rewritten Open WebUI in Rust, significantly reducing memory and resource usage, requiring no dependency services, no Docker, with both a server version and a Tauri-based desktop client. (formerly Open WebUI Lite)

en-US.description: Open CoreUI - A rewritten Open WebUI in Rust, significantly reducing memory and resource usage, requiring no dependency services, no Docker, with both a server version and a Tauri-based desktop client. (formerly Open WebUI Lite)
en-US.longDescription:
Open CoreUI, a lightweight implementation of Open WebUI
Features
- A desktop client with a single executable download to get started
- Use original frontend
- No Docker, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis dependencies required
- Lower memory footprint compared to original version (much lower)
- Lower hardware requirements compared to original version
- Better performance with Rust backend server compared to original version
en-US.name: Open CoreUI Desktop

zh-CN.description: Open CoreUI - 一个用 Rust 重写的 Open WebUI，显著降低了内存和资源占用，无需依赖服务，无需 Docker，提供服务器版本以及基于 Tauri 的桌面客户端。（原 Open WebUI Lite）
zh-CN.longDescription:
Open CoreUI，一个轻量级的 Open WebUI 实现
功能
- 提供桌面客户端，只需下载单个可执行文件即可开始使用
- 使用原始前端
- 无需 Docker、Python、PostgreSQL、Redis 等依赖
- 相比原版本内存占用更低（显著降低）
- 硬件要求低于原版本
- 采用 Rust 后端服务器，性能优于原版本
